limitations: Review-only assessment; no reset, resume, restart command API or authorization even at OPERATOR_REVIEW.
No real XY/home, product pose, vacuum or PLC/E-stop acknowledgements; mandatory operator checks remain unresolved.
Only simulated received data and context used; no injected-fault labels/outage schedule supplied to assessor.
Fresh data does not establish sensor health or stopped physical motion; local zero commands are not PLC feedback.
Functional tests use 1s predictor budget; not 20ms realtime qualification.
Single-product shared-clock provisional MuJoCo plant; no full CAD V5 synchronization or physical validation.
No accepted tagging, public registry push or remote CI run.
